decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology that survived the firm's 2019 cut of its system-level products. That suggests management refocused its search and resources onto tube products like this one rather than counting it as a shortfall, though the missing website evidence since 2020 leaves some uncertainty.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's established heat-transfer competence and were kept when four other launches were dropped. That implies they met the aspiration level and should be carried forward as part of the narrowed portfolio.
